name: colibri-review
description: A rigorous, context-aware code review & debug protocol: one file at a time, context before code, adversarially verified findings, five modes. The LOCAL agent (in-session GLM) is THE reviewer (owner order 2026-10-09); external passes are optional second opinions riding the gate pins; the gate stays always external - deliberate non-unification. Three empty model types still lock a file+mode until its bytes change. Phase-1 context packs query the RSI prevention ruleset (advisory, budget-capped; findings may cite RSI-nnnn).
